2607.02383.title: Know Your Source: A Public Knowledge Store for Media Background Checks
2607.02383.paper_summary: LLM-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly used for automated fact-checking (AFC) and related tasks. By grounding LLM outputs in retrieved evidence, RAG-based systems provide transparent justifications while allowing external information to be updated independently of the underlying model. However, existing approaches often assume retrieved evidence is reliable, although real-world information may be conflicting, outdated, and can originate from unreliable or biased sources. Recent work on *source-critical reasoning* addresses this challenge through media background checks (MBCs) (Schlichtkrull, 2024), which assess the credibility of evidence sources to support downstream fact verification. However, generating MBCs relies on costly proprietary search APIs, limiting reproducibility. To mitigate this issue, we introduce MEDIAREF, a publicly available knowledge store of web-sourced documents that enables reproducible, low-cost evaluation of MBC generation across 200 media sources. We describe a reproducible methodology for constructing and updating the collection, assess widely used LLMs on the MBC generation task, and demonstrate that MEDIAREF supports higher-quality MBC generation through both automatic and qualitative evaluation.
2607.02383.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於檢索增強生成 (RAG) 正在越來越多地用於自動事實檢查 (AFC) 和相關任務。<lb/>通過將 LLM 輸出與檢索到的證據相結合，基於 RAG 的系統提供透明的理由，同時允許外部信息獨立於基礎模型進行更新。<lb/>然而，現有的方法通常假設檢索到的證據是可靠的，儘管現實世界的信息可能存在衝突、過時，並且可能來自不可靠或有偏見的來源。<lb/>最近關於 *來源關鍵推理* 的研究通過媒體背景檢查 (MBCs) (Schlichtkrull, 2024) 解決了這一挑戰，該方法評估證據來源的可信度以支持下游的事實驗證。<lb/>然而，生成 MBCs 依賴於昂貴的專有搜索 API，限制了可重複性。<lb/>為了減輕這一問題，我們引入了 MEDIAREF，這是一個公開可用的網絡來源文檔知識庫，能夠在 200 個媒體來源中實現可重複的、低成本的 MBC 生成評估。<lb/>我們描述了一種可重複的方法來構建和更新該集合，評估廣泛使用的 LLM 在 MBC 生成任務上的表現，並展示 MEDIAREF 通過自動和定性評估支持更高質量的 MBC 生成。
